allowedSourceMaterial.overview: A former gunslinger is forced to take up arms again when he and his cattle crew are threatened by a corrupt lawman.

facts.overview: A former gunslinger is forced to take up arms again when he and his cattle crew are threatened by a corrupt lawman.
facts.title: Open Range

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: When local authority turns hostile, how far will a reformed gunslinger go to protect his crew on the open range?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Directed by Kevin Costner, this frontier Western follows a former gunslinger forced to take up arms again after a corrupt lawman menaces his cattle crew.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: A deliberate, suspenseful Western balancing moderate dramatic weight with steady frontier tension.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Costner delivers an exciting, deliberate Western driven by mounting suspense and classic frontier standoffs between working cattlemen and corrupt authority.

sourceEvidence.notes: The description matches the overview closely: a former gunslinger, forced to take up arms again, a cattle crew, and a corrupt lawman as the threat. 'Menaces' is a light paraphrase of 'threatened'. 'Frontier Western' is genre shorthand supported by the Western genre and the keywords (19th century, cowboy, cattle).
'Directed by Kevin Costner' and 'Costner delivers' match facts.director. Neither phrase makes any claim beyond the director credit.

In curiosityHook, 'local authority turns hostile' paraphrases 'threatened by a corrupt lawman'. 'Protect his crew' follows from the crew being threatened and from the gunslinger taking up arms. 'On the open range' echoes the title and the cattle setting. 'How far will he go' is a rhetorical framing that asserts no outcome.

'Classic frontier standoffs' in whyWatch is supported by the keywords 'shootout', 'crooked sheriff' and 'lawman'. 'Working cattlemen' follows from 'cattle crew' and the keywords 'cattle' and 'cowboy'. 'Mounting suspense' fits the suspenseful mood classification.

acceptedSemanticClassification supports vibeSummary and whyWatch: moods 'exciting' and 'suspenseful', emotional weight 'moderate' and pace 'medium'. 'Steady frontier tension' fits a medium pace. 'Deliberate' is a slight stylistic reading of a medium pace, not a factual claim.

'Reformed' (curiosityHook) is not stated in the packet. The overview says only 'former gunslinger' who is 'forced to take up arms again'. 'Reformed' mildly implies a deliberate change of ways, but it is a low-risk characterization consistent with 'former' and 'forced', and it adds no plot mechanic, motive or outcome.
